seedMechanism: SDK fixture sets the existing Host explicit replay seed field before Start; legal encounter assembly uses unchanged Combat.new(seed17) and Core.draw. os.clock/os.time are not modified.
scope: Independent opt-in one-VM count-only replay of the same ten stages; no replacement or adjustment of the three original timing/memory baseline reports.

hook.propertyRead: Calls to the original native Control readFn; includes unknown-field reads returning nil, excludes method lookup that resolves directly to a callback.
hook.propertyWrite: Calls to the original native Control writeFn; records attempts including rejected writes.
hook.getMethod: Invocations of the original Control C callback whose method name begins Get; includes GetChild/GetChildren; method lookup alone does not count.
hook.setMethod: Invocations of the original Control C callback whose method name begins Set; records request attempts.
hook.semantics: Reflect.apply forwards original this, all arguments, return value and exceptions. Original allowFn remains the identical reference. No wrapper invokes or mutates the Lua stack.
hook.callbackOutcome: Returned means the original callback returned without JavaScript throw, not that a visual/state change succeeded. No-op writes and nil reads remain attempts. Throws are retained, never subtracted from attempts.
hook.excludedObserver: Only explicit read-only status()/readiness Lua queries are suppressed. Native JS inspection does not invoke this Lua C boundary. Fixture commands calling production refresh remain included.
hook.sdkInternal: SDK JS-internal calls such as FindChild recursively calling GetChild are not counted as additional Lua-native C requests.

limitations: One fresh VM, not three repetitions; call counts depend on CPU-budgeted readiness progress and cannot be relabelled as the earlier three raw baselines.
Timings retained inside the raw count-only report are observer overhead observations, not improvement attribution or new timing thresholds.
True V25 uses native full-source UI, so componentBridge proxy counters are NA; no invented zero.
This measures SDK Lua-to-Control API requests, not official engine setters/GPU work or device FPS.
The source identity remains fc98f4e3 exactly; later dead-guard source changes are not silently attached to this candidate.
